name: Terada
source: Terada is the gym teacher at Miyanomori High School. [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url] has always been wary of him due to his strict and disciplinarian nature. The old PE teacher's also a very nasty pervert with no moral compass on how to behave at times. Due to Takuya's trouble with switching [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]his gender[/url] all too often, he might really need to pay attention not to allow himself to get noticed by the lecherous teacher.
